overview_description.description:
Pinnacle provides full-cycle quality assurance and application testing services to its clients. The company’s portfolio of services includes QA consulting, lifecycle testing, quality assurance, web testing, security testing, pre-certification, test automation, device testing, and documentation.

Pinnacle was founded by Abhinav Krishna and is based in Singapore.
